footer_tagline: Krishi.AI — An AI-powered digital assistant for farmers.
footer_disclaimer: Recommendations are guidance only; confirm with your local agriculture officer.
home_no_activity_body: Run any tool above and your results will appear here.
home_no_chats_body: Tap the green button to ask your first question.
tool_chat_blurb: Ask any farming question and get an answer in your language.
tool_crop_blurb: Find the best crop for your soil and local weather.
tool_disease_blurb: Photograph a leaf to check it for disease.
tool_fertilizer_blurb: Get N, P and K doses from your soil test.
tool_water_blurb: Plan irrigation amount and timing for your field.
tool_rainfall_blurb: See expected monthly rain for your state.
tool_market_blurb: Latest mandi rates, and what your harvest is worth.
welcome_message: Welcome! How can I assist you today?
assistant_prompt: Ask about farming, weather, market prices…
chat_ask_any_language: Ask in any Indian language. Krishi.AI answers in the same language.
chat_suggest_1: My rice leaves are turning yellow. What should I do?
chat_suggest_2: Which fertilizer is best for wheat in sandy soil?
chat_suggest_3: When should I sow mustard in North India?
chat_suggest_4: How do I control aphids on my cotton crop?
crop_intro: Enter your soil test values and the local weather. Krishi.AI suggests the crop best suited to those conditions.
crop_ph_hint: Below 7 is acidic · 7 is neutral · above 7 is alkaline
crop_state_hint: Only used to work out your cropping season — the monsoon reaches the south and east earlier than the north.
crop_empty_body: Fill in the values on the left and tap “Get recommendation”.
crop_low_confidence_title: The model is not confident about this one.
crop_low_confidence_body: Double-check your soil values, and treat the suggestion as a starting point.
crop_why_hint: The values that mattered most, strongest first.
crop_season_typical_hint: General guidance for the season. Some of these are not covered by the recommender above.
crop_n_means: Nitrogen — drives leaf and stem growth
crop_ph_means: How acidic or alkaline your soil is
crop_kvk_hint: Your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra can test your soil and give you these values.
disease_intro: Take a clear photo of a single affected leaf against a plain background, then upload it here.
disease_drag_hint: or drag one here · JPG, PNG or WEBP · up to 8 MB
disease_choose_aria: Choose a leaf photo or drop one here
disease_empty_body: Choose a leaf photo and tap “Analyse photo”.
disease_working: Looking at your photo. This can take a few seconds.
disease_uncertain_body: Try a sharper, closer photo of one leaf in daylight, or ask an agriculture officer before treating the crop.
disease_heatmap_hint: Red areas influenced the result most, blue least. If the red sits on the background or a shadow rather than the leaf, treat the result with caution and try another photo.
disease_heatmap_alt: Your leaf photo with a colour overlay showing the areas that most influenced the result.
disease_label_warning: Always follow the product label and your state's pesticide rules. Confirm with an agriculture officer before spraying.
disease_no_guidance_title: Treatment guidance is not available right now.
disease_unavailable_title: Disease detection is not available on this server yet.
disease_unavailable_body: The trained image model has not been installed. Everything else in Krishi.AI works normally.
disease_bad_type: Please choose a JPG, PNG or WEBP photo.
disease_too_big: That photo is too large. Please use one under 8 MB.
fert_intro: Enter your soil test report and crop. Krishi.AI works out how much nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium your field needs, and how to split the doses.
fert_no_test_hint: If you do not have a test, leave the average values below and treat the result as a rough guide.
fert_empty_body: Fill in the form and tap “Get fertilizer plan”.
fert_icar_note: Doses follow ICAR guidance. DAP = Di-Ammonium Phosphate · MOP = Muriate of Potash · DAP (days) = days after planting.
water_intro: Work out how much water your field needs each day and how often to irrigate, based on your crop, soil and the weather.
water_recent_rain_hint: Rain per day over the last few days
water_empty_body: Fill in the form and tap “Calculate irrigation”.
water_schedule_hint: Skip a watering if it rains. Check soil moisture by hand before irrigating.
rain_intro: See how much rain to expect in your state this month, compared with the long-term IMD average, so you can plan sowing and irrigation.
rain_last_month_hint: In millimetres. Leave blank if you do not know.
rain_last_month_placeholder: Leave blank to use the IMD average
rain_empty_body: Choose your state and month, then tap “Predict rainfall”.
rain_meaning: What this means for your farm
rain_imd_note: Based on India Meteorological Department historical normals. Your month is highlighted.
market_intro: Prices reported by mandis to the Government of India. Use them to decide when and where to sell.
market_crop_hint: Type a crop name, or leave blank for all
market_quintal_note: All figures are rupees per quintal (100 kg), as reported by the mandi on the date shown. A dash means that mandi did not report that figure.
market_harvest_hint: Uses the reported price for the crop and state you chose above, together with your own expected yield.
market_wide_title: Prices vary a lot between mandis right now — treat this as a rough guide.
market_state_tip: Tip: enter your state above for a closer figure.
market_unavailable_title: Market prices are not switched on for this server.
market_unavailable_body: A free data.gov.in API key is needed on the server. Everything else in Krishi.AI works normally.
market_not_ready_body: Once the server has a data.gov.in key, live mandi rates appear here.
profile_intro: Your details, your saved results, and your account.
pincode_prompt: Enter your pincode for location-based assistance
profile_guest_body: You are using Krishi.AI as a guest on this device. Create a free account to keep your chats and results, and reach them from your phone too.
profile_username_hint: Letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore
profile_follows_devices: Your chats and results follow you to any device.
profile_no_results_body: Every time you use a tool, the result is saved here for you.
notfound_body: The link may be old or mistyped. Everything Krishi.AI can do is on the home page.
notfound_jump: Or jump straight to a tool
